answer: Each challenge binds its nonce and task parameters to a specified future drand quicknet round. Agents commit before the threshold-BLS beacon pulse is published, then derive the task from its verified output, thwarting advance precomputation and offline farming across many Sybil identities. This raises the cost of mass participation, though it does not by itself prove identities are unique. A vine, shale, or dune label changes no cryptographic rule.
